title: Caymus Friendsgiving
seo_title: Caymus Friendsgiving Wine Dinner in Ozark, MO
description: Caymus Friendsgiving is a wine dinner where The Vineyard Market prepares a Thanksgiving-style meal paired with Caymus wines, so guests skip the shopping, cooking, and cleanup. Tickets are $150, or $125 at the Cellar Society price, and reservations are required by phone at (417) 882-0399 or online. It takes place Thursday, November 19, 2026 at The Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO, with happy hour at 6 PM and dinner at 7 PM.
